SELECT rbt.batch_id AS batchId, COALESCE(fn.id, filen.id) AS id, COALESCE(fn.name, filen.name) AS name, CASE WHEN fn.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'folder' ELSE 'file' END AS type, COALESCE(filen.file_size, 0) AS size, COALESCE(fn.created_at, filen.created_at) AS createdAt, COALESCE(fn.deleted_at, filen.deleted_at) AS deletedAt, COALESCE(fn.version, filen.version) AS version
FROM recycle_bin_tasks rbt
LEFT JOIN folder_nodes fn ON rbt.root_node_id = fn.id AND rbt.node_type = 0 -- 移除 directory_status 过滤，允许查询所有状态的节点
LEFT JOIN file_nodes filen ON rbt.root_node_id = filen.id AND rbt.node_type = 1 -- 移除 directory_status 过滤，允许查询所有状态的节点
WHERE rbt.user_id = #{userId} AND rbt.operation_type = 0 AND rbt.status IN (0, 1) -- 仅查询"进行中"或"已完成"的删除任务
AND rbt.created_at < ( SELECT created_at FROM recycle_bin_tasks WHERE batch_id = #{lastBatchId} AND user_id = #{userId} )
ORDER BY rbt.created_at DESC
LIMIT #{maxPageSize}
